note: The levels are the survey's answers, written to stand alone; three columns need a form to sit in a sentence. The age band becomes the clause 'je mi mezi 18 a 24 lety'. The income reads 'do 25.000 Kč' and 'více než 40.000 Kč' inside 'Příjem naší domácnosti je ...'. The education drops the noun the sentence already has ('mé vzdělání je vysokoškolské', not '... vysokoškolské vzdělání'). Income and education are worded as the survey dataset words them (datasets/sod/forms.json). The retired grids spliced both as they stand, because their runs were sent so.
